creation: Archived the source commit without modifying repository refs.
Restored its pinned dependencies in an isolated legacy-only checkout using npm ci --ignore-scripts; used the unmodified Windows x64 prebuild already shipped in the npm package.
Verified the tarball against the pinned SHA-512 integrity and all 68 installed package files against the tarball.
Built the archived source and applied its four migrations through production openDatabase.
Seeded synthetic state through RuntimeConfigStore, AccountDirectory, AccountModelPreferences, TelemetryRecorder and SqliteResponsesHistory with the fixed clock.
Captured expected-state.json through the legacy driver before WAL checkpoint(TRUNCATE) and close; integrity_check returned ok and foreign_key_check was empty.
notes: All persisted identities, models, usage, events and tool-call history are synthetic. No real credentials or request/response content.
Credential sentinels existed only in MemoryCredentialStore and were not persisted.
The original database has no required WAL/SHM sidecars. Always test a copy and use fixedNowMs to avoid intentional retention cleanup.
The isolated legacy --ignore-scripts setup is not evidence about candidate installation requirements.
